segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.description: Collects royalties and lease income from oil and gas operators who explore and produce on Company land.
segments.evidence: CKX leases its property to oil and gas operators and collects income through its land ownership in the form of oil and gas royalties and lease rentals and geophysical revenues.

segments.name: Timber
segments.description: Actively manages and sells timber from Company lands to buyers through competitive bids and pay-as-cut contracts.
segments.evidence: Timber income is derived from sales of timber on Company lands.

segments.name: Surface
segments.description: Earns recurring and non-recurring surface income from leasing Company land for farming, hunting, commercial and right-of-way uses.
segments.evidence: Recurring surface income is earned from lease arrangements for farming, recreational and commercial uses.

revenueModel.text: CKX is paid by oil and gas operators through royalties on production, by timber buyers under pay-as-cut stumpage contracts, and by tenants under surface leases for farming, hunting, right-of-way and commercial uses.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company receives royalties on all oil and gas produced by the customer.
